title: Aerobic run
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 60min steady aerobic at 135-145bpm, flat to rolling, D+ under 150m. icu load 55, Garmin ~65-80.
GYM: Copenhagen 2x30s/side only.
FUEL: none (water if warm).
STOP RULE: quads or knee sore after Saturday, swap for a 75min spin at 120-135bpm.
WHY: back-to-back aerobic volume on tired legs, the Wk3 weekend pattern in small.
